Chapter 2: The Power of Setting Outrageous Goals and Refusing to Settle.
So, once you start to believe that extraordinary achievement is truly possible, the next big step is figuring out what that actually means for you. It’s about setting goals that aren’t just big—they’re almost outrageous. We’re talking about the kind of objectives that stretch your imagination and make you wonder, “Wow, could I really pull this off?”
Most of us have been told to aim for what’s reasonable—to set realistic goals and stick to what feels safe. Sure, that approach can help you make steady progress, but let’s be honest: it rarely leads to those breakthrough, game-changing results. Outrageous goals? Well, they have a different energy. They light a fire under you, create real excitement, and push you to think and act in ways you never have before.
But let’s get something clear—setting bold goals isn’t about wishful thinking or just talking a big game. There’s a real process behind it, and it starts with figuring out what truly matters to you.
Outrageous goals are rooted in your deepest values and your real passions. They aren’t handed down by someone else; they come from a place of purpose inside you.
Next, picture what it looks like to achieve that goal. Really see it in your mind—almost as if it’s already happened. This kind of visualization helps you map out the steps you’ll need to get there.
And then, break that huge goal into smaller, actionable steps. Even the wildest objective can be tackled one step at a time.
But here’s the catch—half-hearted effort won’t cut it. You’ve got to commit, fully and without holding back. Because when you go all in, that’s when the extraordinary starts to happen.
Now, let’s be real. Chasing after outrageous goals can bring up fear and self-doubt. That’s totally normal. In fact, those feelings are a sign that what you’re aiming for actually matters to you. Instead of letting fear stop you, use it as a signal: you’re on the right track.
Think about an entrepreneur who dreams of building a company that changes the game in their industry. At first, that goal can feel impossible—especially with tough competition and limited resources. But by breaking it down—like building a prototype, landing those first customers, and pulling together a great team—the path forward slowly takes shape.
Of course, there’ll be setbacks along the way. That’s just part of the deal with outrageous goals. If you stumble or even fail, it doesn’t mean your dream is out of reach. Every setback teaches you something new about what works and what doesn’t. The key is to learn, adjust, and keep moving.
So, here are a few practical tips for setting and actually going after outrageous goals:
First, aim higher than feels comfortable. If your goal doesn’t make you a little nervous, you might need to think even bigger.
Write your goal down and look at it often. Keeping it in sight helps you stay focused and motivated.
Share your goal with people you trust. Having support and someone to hold you accountable can make a huge difference.
And don’t forget to celebrate the small wins along the way. Every bit of progress counts, and those little victories will keep you moving forward.
When you refuse to settle for less than what you truly want, you give yourself the chance to achieve things that once felt impossible. It’s not always easy, but if you’re willing to commit and keep going—even through the challenges—amazing things can happen.
